dedupe_keys.name: eurostat municipal waste by waste management operations env wasmun

description: This Eurostat table gives the amount of municipal waste each European country generates and how it is managed: treated, landfilled and otherwise disposed, incinerated with or without energy recovery, recycled as material, composted or digested, and prepared for reuse, in thousand tonnes and per inhabitant. The producer is Eurostat, the statistical office of the European Union, from national reports under EU waste statistics and waste framework legislation. Coverage is the EU member states, EFTA and candidate countries (38 reporting countries in 2022) with EU aggregates, annually from 1995 to 2024. Data are free through the Eurostat data browser and a dissemination API in JSON-stat, SDMX and TSV, reusable under Eurostat's policy, which follows Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Caveats: definitions and calculation rules changed over time, some values are estimates or breaks in series, and treatment operations need not sum to generation because of stock and export effects. Simulation uses: national flows of waste to landfill, incineration and recycling capacity for waste system capacity planning, and baselines for disruption scenarios in which treatment plants are lost. Related records: the What a Waste global database (data-what-a-waste-global-database) covers the rest of the world.
